sources.title: Introducing GPT-5.1 for developers
sources.evidence: November 13, 2025 announcement explicitly releases gpt-5.1-codex-mini in the API and identifies the Codex variants as specialized for coding agents. General GPT-5.1 benchmarks are not mini specifications.

sources.title: Codex changelog
sources.evidence: Complete HTML fetched and relevant text inspected. November 13, 2025 explicitly introduces gpt-5.1-codex-mini in Codex alongside the API launch; the distinct gpt-5-codex-mini appeared November 7. April 7, 2026 entry announces removal of this exact 5.1 mini from Codex with ChatGPT sign-in on April 14.

sources.title: GPT-5.1-Codex Mini model documentation
sources.evidence: Complete current Markdown identifies exact alias, 400,000 context, 128,000 maximum output, text/image input and text output, reasoning tokens, function calling, Responses support and prompt caching. Only undated alias appears in snapshots. Status is shut down. No numerical model size or routing specification.

sources.title: Prompt caching
sources.evidence: Current guide explicitly names gpt-5.1-codex-mini in the extended-retention support list, independently corroborating exact-model caching capability.

sources.title: Prompt Caching 201
sources.evidence: Archived guide explicitly applies to models before GPT-5.6 and explains prompt caching through Transformer attention-layer key/value projections and tensors. Together with exact model support this permits a qualified operational Transformer inference, not a full block or routing specification.

sources.title: File inputs
sources.evidence: Responses PDF input is converted into extracted text and page images for models with vision. This establishes an API file format when joined to exact mini image and Responses support, not another native modality.

sources.title: API deprecations
sources.evidence: April 22, 2026 notice explicitly records gpt-5.1-codex-mini API shutdown on July 23, 2026. This agrees with current model-page status and is separate from earlier Codex ChatGPT-sign-in retirement.

sources.title: OpenAI Services Agreement
sources.evidence: Current sections 2.2 and 9.1 grant limited service access and reserve service intellectual-property rights. Supports descriptive proprietary classification, not an open checkpoint license or reconstruction of exact launch-day terms.

sources.title: All OpenAI API models
sources.evidence: Current catalog lists exact GPT-5.1-Codex Mini as a retired hosted model, separately from its explicit open-weight gpt-oss section.

sources.title: GPT-5.1-Codex-Max System Card
sources.evidence: Later 27-page card and extracted text were checked for retrospective exact-mini disclosure. It compares original 5.1-Codex and Max, but supplies no exact 5.1-Codex-Mini parameter count or architecture. Max-specific training and compaction are not transferred.

sources.title: Update to GPT-5 System Card: GPT-5.2
sources.evidence: Later 27-page card and extracted text were checked for exact mini comparison/count/architecture disclosures. GPT-5.1 Thinking, Instant and Codex-Max comparisons do not establish 5.1-Codex-Mini size or topology; no exact-mini numerical count was found.

sources.title: A Practical Approach to Verifying Code at Scale
sources.evidence: First-party training research describes GPT-5.1-Codex code-review training and inference-budget comparisons. It does not identify a 5.1-Codex-Mini structural or numerical parameter specification, so full-size reviewer evidence is not transferred.

name.note: Official exact API display name; normalizes hyphenation and capitalization.

developer.note: First-party launch and documentation establish the developer.

family.note: Exact release-family grouping, distinct from the original GPT-5-Codex-Mini and cross-generation Codex grouping.

release_date.note: Both original developer announcement and Codex changelog explicitly introduce this exact model November 13. The November 7 predecessor is another model.

open_weights.note: Documented distribution is hosted Codex/API access under reserved service rights. No exact-model weight artifact is offered in the inspected primary material.

license.note: Descriptive hosted-model classification, not an SPDX identifier or open-weight license.

parameters_b.note: Total parameters remain undisclosed in the exact model page/release and checked later cards and training research. Targeted first-party architecture and interpretability searches found no exact-mini count. Relative size, price and naming do not establish a number. This is a bounded review.

active_parameters_b.note: No exact per-token active count or dense/MoE routing specification was disclosed in the reviewed sources. Other mini models and Max are not substitutes.

architecture.note: Qualified cross-source operational inference: exact mini supports prompt caching, and the applicable pre-GPT-5.6 guide explains Transformer attention KV projections. This does not establish exclusive Transformer layers, complete block inventory, dimensions, dense/MoE routing or parameter counts.

context_window.note: Exact API context window. The separate 128,000 maximum output is not added to it; no maximum input is stated or derived. Compaction behavior of other Codex models does not change this limit.

modalities.note: Native inputs are text/image and output is text. PDF denotes Responses API preprocessing into text/page images for the documented vision model; absence of a file_uploads flag is not a documented denial.

reasoning.note: Exact mini documentation explicitly supports reasoning tokens. General GPT-5.1 none-mode defaults are not transferred to this variant.

tool_call.note: Exact model documentation explicitly supports function calling in Responses.

description.value: GPT-5.1 coding variant with text and image input, reasoning, function calling and a 400,000-token context window.
description.note: Plain description of documented exact-model capabilities.

patch.name: GPT-5.1-Codex Mini
patch.description: GPT-5.1 coding variant with text and image input, reasoning, function calling and a 400,000-token context window.

sources.label: Update to GPT-5 System Card: GPT-5.2
A Practical Approach to Verifying Code at Scale

patch.notes: GPT-5.1-Codex Mini launched in Codex and the API on November 13, 2025, separately from GPT-5-Codex-Mini on November 7. Its API page lists only the undated alias, with no dated immutable snapshot. Context is 400,000 tokens and maximum output is 128,000; no maximum input is stated. PDF denotes API conversion into text and page images. Transformer is a qualified operational inference from exact caching support and the pre-GPT-5.6 attention-KV explanation; complete block design, dense/MoE routing and total/active parameter counts remain undisclosed in the checked sources. Codex access with ChatGPT sign-in ended April 14, 2026, and API access shut down July 23, 2026. These are last-documented capabilities; no inference request was made.

summary: Confirmed November 13 release for the exact 5.1 Codex mini, distinct from the November 7 predecessor. Corrected display name, release-family and license classification; added API PDF support and qualified broad Transformer inference, and replaced generic copy. Confirmed 400K context, reasoning and function calls. Parameter counts remain undisclosed after original and later primary checks. Recorded separate Codex and API retirements.
